title: Bind shared storefront to live and draft read/quote data
acceptance_criteria: Inject explicit profile, catalog/tariff, mode, cart/receipt, and submission contracts through the shared flow without changing protected rendered presentation or assets; prove price rounding parity for all 12 models.
Implement public profile/catalog/revision and validated quote reads, frozen manifest merge, route-only mode selection and anonymous live checkout session/CSRF with a basic visibility/access guard.

Preserve standalone demo's existing local namespace without server writes; isolate embed, draft preview and live in memory, reset live cart on tenant change, and prove no demo fallback, persistence leaks, or query-flag mode switches. Draft preview shows saved draft and cannot submit.
deliverables: Shared storefront data flow, public read/quote contracts, draft preview integration and preservation comparisons
